summary: Use one deterministic MIME-derived name for an unnamed Outlook MSG attachment from parsing through selected import.
decision_refs: The active goal requires better RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
The user requested ponytail optimization with open-source reuse instead of unnecessary custom code
An offline reproduction showed parser and selection names disagreeing for the same unnamed MSG PDF
approval_evidence: The persistent user goal explicitly requires continued accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: The change only normalizes unnamed MSG attachment display/import names; supplied names remain unchanged.
Attachments remain inert until explicitly selected and are never analyzed automatically.
Mailbox synchronization and automatic recursive attachment import remain unsupported.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer email, mailbox, provider API or paid model is used.
